H5438.d: from סָבַב; a (providential) turn (of affairs); cause.

H5085.d: (Aramaic) from the same as נָדָן; a sheath; figuratively, the body (as the receptacle of the soul); body.

H5245.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to נָמֵר; {a leopard (from its stripes)}; leopard.

H5040.d: from נָבָל; properly, disgrace, i.e. the (female) pudenda; lewdness.

H5287.d: a primitive root (probably identical with נָעַר, through the idea of the rustling of mane, which usually accompanies the lion's roar); to tumble about; shake (off, out, self), overthrow, toss up and down.
r: even thus be he shaken out
i am tossed up and down

H5235.d: or נֹכֶר; from נָכַר; something strange, i.e. unexpected calamity; strange.

H5062.d: a primitive root; to push, gore, defeat, stub (the toe), inflict (a disease); beat, dash, hurt, plague, slay, smite (down), strike, stumble, [idiom] surely, put to the worse.
r: against you and ye shall be slain

H5059.d: a primitive root; properly, to thrum, i.e. beat atune with the fingers; expectation. to play on astringed instrument; hence (generally), to make music; player on instruments, sing to the stringed instruments, melody, ministrel, play(-er, -ing).
r: came to pass when the minstrel

H5338.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to נָצַל; to extricate; deliver, rescue.

H5010.d: a primitive root; to reject; abhor, make void.

H5405.d: a primitive root; properly, to eliminate, i.e. (intransitively) to dry up; fail.

H5057.d: or נָגִד; from נָגַד; a commander (as occupying the front), civil, military or religious; generally (abstractly, plural), honorable themes; captain, chief, excellent thing, (chief) governor, leader, noble, prince, (chief) ruler.

H5069.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to נָדַב; be (or give) liberal(-ly); (be minded of...own) freewill (offering), offer freely (willingly).

H5306.d: from an unused root meaning to glisten; shining; a gem, probably the garnet; emerald.

H5200.d: patronymic from נְטֹפָה; a Netophathite, or inhabitant of Netophah; Netophathite.

H5350.d: from the same as נָקֹד; a crumb (as broken to spots); also a biscuit (as pricked); cracknel, mouldy.

H5146.d: the same as נוּחַ; rest; Noach, the patriarch of the flood; Noah.

H5271.d: or נָעֻר; and (feminine) נְעֻרָה; properly, passive participle from נַעַר as denominative; (only in plural collectively or emphatic form) youth, the state (juvenility) or the persons (young people); childhood, youth.

H5199.d: from נָטַף; distillation; Netophah, a place in Palestine; Netophah.

H5095.d: a primitive root; properly, to run with asparkle, i.e. flow; hence (transitively), to conduct, and (by inference) to protect, sustain; carry, feed, guide, lead (gently, on).

H5070.d: from נָדַב; liberal; Nadab, the name of four Israelites; Nadab.

H5423.d: a primitive root; to tear off; break (off), burst, draw (away), lift up, pluck (away, off), pull (out), root out.

H5117.d: a primitive root; to rest, i.e. settle down; used in a great variety of applications, literal and figurative, intransitive, transitive and causative (to dwell, stay, let fall, place, let alone, withdraw, give comfort, etc.); cease, be confederate, lay, let down, (be) quiet, remain, (cause to, be at, give, have, make to) rest, set down. Compare יָנִים.

H5369.d: the same as נִיר; lamp; Ner, an Israelite; Ner.

H5363.d: from נָקַף; a threshing (of olives); shaking.

H5401.d: a primitive root (identical with נָשַׂק, through the idea of fastening up; compare חָזַק, חָשַׁק); to kiss, literally or figuratively (touch); also (as a mode of attachment), to equip with weapons; armed (men), rule, kiss, that touched.
r: let me i pray thee kiss

H5472.d: a primitive root; properly, to flinch, i.e. (by implication) to go back, literally (to retreat) or figuratively (to apostatize); backslider, drive, go back, turn (away, back).
r: every one of them is gone back

H5072.d: from נָדַב and יָהּ; largess of Jah; Nedabjah, an Israelite; Nedabiah.

H5175.d: from נָחַשׁ; a snake (from its hiss); serpent.
r: came to pass that if a serpent

H5304.d: plural from an unused root meaning to scatter; expansions; Nephisim, a Temple-servant; Nephusim (from the margin).

H5344.d: a primitive root; to puncture, literally (to perforate, with more or less violence) or figuratively (to specify, designate, libel); appoint, blaspheme, bore, curse, express, with holes, name, pierce, strike through.

H5193.d: a primitive root; properly, to strike in, i.e. fix; specifically, to plant (literally or figuratively); fastened, plant(-er).

H5461.d: from an unused root meaning to superintend; a prefect of a province; prince, ruler.

H5265.d: a primitive root; properly, to pull up, especially the tent-pins, i.e. start on ajourney; cause to blow, bring, get, (make to) go (away, forth, forward, onward, out), (take) journey, march, remove, set aside (forward), [idiom] still, be on his (go their) way.

H5299.d: from נוּף in the sense of lifting; a height; also a sieve; border, coast, region, sieve.

H5098.d: a primitive root; to growl; mourn, roar(-ing).

H5149.d: from נָחַם; comforted; Nechum, an Israelite; Nehum.

H5216.d: or נִר; also נֵיר; or נֵר; or (feminine) נֵרָה; from a primitive root (see נִיר; נוּר) properly, meaning to glisten; a lamp (i.e. the burner) or light (literally or figuratively); candle, lamp, light.

H5445.d: a primitive root; to carry (literally or figuratively), or (reflexively) be burdensome; specifically, to be gravid; bear, be a burden, carry, strong to labour.

H5439.d: or (feminine) סְבִיבָה; from סָבַב; (as noun) a circle, neighbour, or environs; but chiefly (as adverb, with or without preposition) around; (place, round) about, circuit, compass, on every side.

H5347.d: from נָקַב; female (from the sexual form); female.

H5108.d: or נֵיב; from נוּב; produce, literally or figuratively; fruit.

H5228.d: from the same as נֵכַח; straightforward, i.e. (figuratively), equitable, correct, or (abstractly), integrity; plain, right, uprightness.

H5482.d: (rather to be written סְוֵנָה; for סְוֵן; i.e to Seven); of Egyptian derivation; Seven, a place in Upper Egypt; Syene.

H5488.d: probably of Egyptian origin; a reed, especially the papyrus; flag, Red (sea), weed. Compare סוּף.

H5272.d: from נוּעַ and אֵל; moved of God; Neiel, a place in Palestine; Neiel.

H5455.d: probably of foreign derivation; Sabteca, the name of a son of Cush, and the region settled by him; Sabtecha, Sabtechah.

H5123.d: a primitive root; to slumber (from drowsiness); sleep, slumber.

H5483.d: or סֻס; from an unused root meaning to skip (properly, for joy); a horse (as leaping); also a swallow (from its rapid flight); crane, horse (-back, -hoof). Compare פָּרָשׁ.

H5384.d: from נָשָׁה, in the sense of failure; rheumatic or crippled (from the incident to Jacob); which shrank.

H5255.d: a primitive root; to tear away; destroy, pluck, root.

H5412.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to נָתִין; {the Nethinim, or Temple-servants (as given to that duty)}; Nethinims.

H5249.d: plural of a masculine corresponding to נִמְרָה; clear waters; Nimrim, a place East of the Jordan; Nimrim. Compare בֵּית נִמְרָה.

H5041.d: apparently from נָבָל and לָט; foolish secrecy; Neballat, a place in Palestine; Neballat.

H5485.d: from סוּס; horse-like; Susi, an Israelite; Susi.

H5487.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to סוּף; to come to an end; consume, fulfill.

H5458.d: from סָגַר; properly, shut up, i.e. the breast (as enclosing the heart); also gold (as generally shut up safely); caul, gold.

H5283.d: the same as נַעֲמָן; Naaman, the name of an Israelite and of a Damascene; Naaman.

H5370.d: of foreign origin; Nergal, a Cuthite deity; Nergal.

H5136.d: a primitive root; to be sick, i.e. (figuratively) distressed; be full of heaviness.

H5065.d: a primitive root; to drive (an animal, a workman, a debtor, an army); by implication, to tax, harass, tyrannize; distress, driver, exact(-or), oppress(-or), [idiom] raiser of taxes, taskmaster.

H5234.d: a primitive root; properly, to scrutinize, i.e. look intently at; hence (with recognition implied), to acknowledge, be acquainted with, care for, respect, revere, or (with suspicion implied), to disregard, ignore, be strange toward, reject, resign, dissimulate (as if ignorant or disowning); acknowledge, [idiom] could, deliver, discern, dissemble, estrange, feign self to be another, know, take knowledge (notice), perceive, regard, (have) respect, behave (make) self strange(-ly).

H5274.d: a primitive root; also denominative from נַעַל; properly, to fasten up, i.e. with abar or cord; hence, to sandal, i.e. furnish with slippers; bolt, inclose, lock, shoe, shut up.

H5464.d: probably from סָגַר in the sense of sweeping away; a pouring rain; very rainy.

H5351.d: feminine of נָקֹד; a boss; stud.

H5473.d: a primitive root (probably rather identical with סוּג through the idea of shrinking from a hedge; compare שׂוּג); to hem in, i.e. bind; set about.

H5296.d: from נָעַר; something shaken out, i.e. tow (as the refuse of flax); tow.

H5279.d: feminine of נַעַם; pleasantness; Naamah, the name of an antediluvian woman, of an Ammonitess, and of a place in Palestine; Naamah.

H5490.d: from סוּף; a termination; conclusion, end, hinder participle

H5017.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to נְבוּאָה; inspired teaching; prophesying.

H5125.d: a primitive root; to resprout, i.e. propagate by shoots; figuratively, to be perpetual; be continued.

H5319.d: from פָּתַל; properly, wrestled; but used (in the plural) transitively, a struggle; wrestling.

H5006.d: a primitive root; in Ecclesiastes 12:5, by interchange for נוּץ, to bloom; to scorn; abhor, (give occasion to) blaspheme, contemn, despise, flourish, [idiom] great, provoke.
r: neither shall any of them that provoked

H5311.d: from נָפַץ; a storm (as dispersing); scattering.

H5150.d: or נִחֻם; from נָחַם; properly, consoled; abstractly, solace; comfort(-able), repenting.

H5238.d: probably for נְכֹאת; spicery, i.e. (generally) valuables; precious things.

H5140.d: a primitive root; to drip, or shed by trickling; distil, drop, flood, (cause to) flow(-ing), gush out, melt, pour (down), running water, stream.

H5406.d: probably of Persian origin; an epistle; letter.

H5002.d: from נָאַם; an oracle; (hath) said, saith.

H5106.d: a primitive root; to refuse, forbid, dissuade, or neutralize; break, disallow, discourage, make of none effect.

H5359.d: from נָקַם; revenge; [phrase] avenged, quarrel, vengeance.

H5340.d: a primitive root; to glare, i.e. be bright-colored; sparkle.

H5224.d: probably of Egyptian origin; Neko, an Egyptian king; Necho. Compare פַּרְעֹה נְכֹה.

H5044.d: of uncertain derivation; Nibshan, a place in Palestine; Nibshan.

H5349.d: active participle from the same as נָקֹד; a spotter (of sheep or cattle), i.e. the owner or tender (who thus marks them); herdman, sheepmaster.

H5475.d: from יָסַד; a session, i.e. company of persons (in close deliberation); by implication, intimacy, consultation, a secret; assembly, consel, inward, secret (counsel).

H5391.d: a primitive root; to strike with a sting (as a serpent); figuratively, to oppress with interest on a loan; bite, lend upon usury.
r: come to pass that every one that is bitten

H5382.d: a primitive root; to forget; figuratively, to neglect; causatively, to remit, remove; forget, deprive, exact.

H5417.d: xlit Nᵉthanêʼl corrected to Nᵉthanʼêl; from נָתַן and אֵל; given of God; Nethanel, the name of ten Israelites; Nethaneel.

H5167.d: from נָחַם; consolatory; Nachamani, an Israelite; Nahamani.

H5075.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to נָדַד; to depart; go from.

H5129.d: from יָעַד and יָהּ; convened of Jah; Noadjah, the name of an Israelite, and a false prophetess; Noadiah.

H5243.d: a primitive root; to become clipped or (specifically) circumcised; (branch to) be cut down (off), circumcise.

H5252.d: feminine participle passive of סָבַב; properly, an environment, i.e. circumstance or turn of affairs; cause.

H5074.d: a primitive root; properly, to wave to and fro (rarely to flap up and down); figuratively, to rove, flee, or (causatively) to drive away; chase (away), [idiom] could not, depart, flee ([idiom] apace, away), (re-) move, thrust away, wander (abroad, -er, -ing).
r: yea he shall be chased away

H5330.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to נָצַח; to become chief; be preferred.

H5425.d: a primitive root; to jump, i.e. be violently agitated; causatively, to terrify, shake off, untie; drive asunder, leap, (let) loose, [idiom] make, move, undo.
r: me that he would let loose

H5067.d: from נוּד in the sense of piling up; a mound, i.e. wave; heap.

H5061.d: from נָגַע; a blow (figuratively, infliction); also (by implication) a spot (concretely, a leprous person or dress); plague, sore, stricken, stripe, stroke, wound.

H5378.d: a primitive root (perhaps identical with נָשָׁא, through the idea of imposition); to lend on interest; by implication, to dun fordebt; [idiom] debt, exact, giver of usury.

H5286.d: a primitive root; to growl; yell.

H5329.d: a primitive root; also as denominative from נֶצַח; properly, to glitter from afar, i.e. to be eminent (as a superintendent, especially of the Temple services and its music); to be permanent; excel, chief musician (singer), oversee(-r), set forward.

H5278.d: from נָעֵם; agreeableness, i.e. delight, suitableness, splendor or grace; beauty, pleasant(-ness).

H5410.d: or (feminine) נְתִיבָה; or נְתִבָה; (Jeremiah 6:16), from an unused root meaning to tramp; a (beaten) track; path(-way), [idiom] travel(-ler), way.

H5385.d: or rather, נְשֻׂאָה; feminine. passive participle of נָשָׂא; something borne, i.e. a load; carriage.

H5387.d: or נָשִׂא; from נָשָׂא; properly, an exalted one, i.e. a king or sheik; also a rising mist; captain, chief, cloud, governor, prince, ruler, vapour.

H5182.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to נָחַת; to descend; causatively, to bring away, deposit, depose; carry, come down, depose, lay up, place.

H5416.d: from נָתַן; given; Nathan, the name of five Israelites; Nathan.

H5419.d: from נָתַן and מֶלֶךְ; given of (the) king; Nethan-Melek, an Israelite; Nathanmelech.

H5184.d: the same as נַחַת; quiet; Nachath, the name of an Edomite and of two Israelites; Nahath.

H5103.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to נָהַר; a river, especially the Euphrates; river, stream.

H5227.d: from the same as נֵכַח; properly, the front part; used adverbially (especially with preposition), opposite, in front of, forward, in behalf of; (over) against, before, direct(-ly), for, right (on).

H5365.d: a primitive root; to bore (penetrate, quarry); dig, pick out, pierce, put (thrust) out.

H5413.d: a primitive root; to flow forth (literally or figuratively); by implication, to liquify; drop, gather (together), melt, pour (forth, out).
r: hast thou not poured me out

H5181.d: a primitive root; to sink, i.e. descend; causatively, to press or lead down; be broken, (cause to) come down, enter, go down, press sore, settle, stick fast.

H5219.d: from נָכֵא; properly, a smiting, i.e. (concretely) an aromatic gum (perhaps styrax) (as powdered); spicery(-ces).

H5433.d: a primitive root; to quaff to satiety, i.e. become tipsy; drunkard, fill self, Sabean, (wine-) bibber.

H5309.d: or נֵפֶל; from נָפַל; something fallen, i.e. an abortion; untimely birth.

H5341.d: a primitive root; to guard, in a good sense (to protect, maintain, obey, etc.) or a bad one (to conceal, etc.); besieged, hidden thing, keep(-er, -ing), monument, observe, preserve(-r), subtil, watcher(-man).

H5078.d: from נָדָה in the sense of freely flinging money; a bounty (for prostitution); gifts.

H5476.d: from סוֹד; a confidant; Sodi, an Israelite; Sodi.

H5467.d: from an unused root meaning to scorch; burnt (i.e. volcanic or bituminous) district; Sedom, a place near the Dead Sea; Sodom.

H5221.d: a primitive root; to strike (lightly or severely, literally or figuratively); beat, cast forth, clap, give (wounds), [idiom] go forward, [idiom] indeed, kill, make (slaughter), murderer, punish, slaughter, slay(-er, -ing), smite(-r, -ing), strike, be stricken, (give) stripes, [idiom] surely, wound.

H5138.d: from זוּד; something boiled, i.e. soup; pottage.

H5019.d: or נְבֻּכַדְנֶאצַּר; (2 Kings 24:1,10), or נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּר; (Esther 2:6; Daniel 1:18), or נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּר; or נְבוּכַדְרֶאצּוֹר; (Ezra 2:1; Jeremiah 49:28), or foreign derivation; Nebukadnetstsar (or -retstsar, or -retstsor), king of Babylon; Nebuchadnezzar, Nebuchadrezzar.

H5408.d: a primitive root; to dismember; cut (in pieces), divide, hew in pieces.
r: themselves and cut it in pieces

H5420.d: a primitive root; to tear up; mar.

H5402.d: or נֵשֶׁק; from נָשַׁק; military equipment, i.e. (collectively) arms (offensive or defensive), or (concretely) an arsenal; armed men, armour(-y), battle, harness, weapon.

H5273.d: from נָעֵם; delightful (objective or subjective, literal or figurative); pleasant(-ure), sweet.

H5327.d: a primitive root; properly, to go forth, i.e. (by implication) to be expelled, and (consequently) desolate; causatively, to lay waste; also (specifically), to quarrel; be laid waste, runinous, strive (together).

H5147.d: from חָבָה; occult; Nachbi, an Israelite; Nakbi.

H5173.d: from נָחַשׁ; an incantation or augury; enchantment.

H5444.d: from סָבַךְ; copse-like; Sibbecai, an Israelite; Sibbecai, Sibbechai.

H5189.d: from נָטַשׁ; a tendril (as an offshoot); battlement, branch, plant.

H5081.d: from נָדַב; properly, voluntary, i.e. generous; hence, magnanimous; as noun, a grandee (sometimes a tyrant); free, liberal (things), noble, prince, willing (hearted).
r: many as were of a free

H5096.d: or נַהֲלֹל; the same as נַהֲלֹל; Nahalal or Nahalol, a place in Palestine; Nahalal, Nahallal, Nahalol.
